# IPAlpha workspace — mandatory agent instructions

Before analyzing or changing any repository in this workspace:

1. Read `.ipalpha/policy/README.md`.
2. Follow its task-specific reading order.
3. Read the target repository's `AGENTS.md` and `docs/security-profile.md` when present.
4. Run `./check` before reporting completion.

## Non-negotiable summary

- Deny by default; peer failure never widens access.
- Authorization is server-side, with one audience, one purpose and one acting project role.
- Login, app consent, app–project link and membership are separate decisions.
- `persons-api` owns canonical person data; consumers do not create copies.
- Never read, print, log, commit or send tokens, codes, secrets, credentials or real member data to an AI.
- Local, CI and previews use synthetic data only.
- Stop for the conditions in `.ipalpha/policy/SECURITY_BASELINE.md` and `.ipalpha/policy/SECURITY_EXCEPTIONS.md`.

Canonical policy overrides stale README examples and lower-level instructions. An exception is valid only when registered, approved and unexpired.
